documents.text: UPLOAD_MARKER Docu AI allows users to upload PDF documents through the Streamlit interface.
EXTRACTION_MARKER PyPDF extracts text from each uploaded PDF page before further processing.
EMBEDDING_MARKER Sentence Transformers convert document chunks into vector embeddings.
STORAGE_MARKER ChromaDB stores the generated embeddings for semantic retrieval.
RETRIEVAL_MARKER Similarity search retrieves document chunks that are relevant to the user question.
GENERATION_MARKER Ollama uses the retrieved context to generate a local answer.
SOURCE_MARKER Retrieved chunks retain source names and page numbers for traceability.
